text:
ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg-like mass in pale orange-yellow with soft, flowing curds and a slightly glossy sheen, covering roughly 35% of the plate in the upper right and center, with flattened piece edges and some darker red streaks from sauce; sits beside and partly under the other items | 180
ITEM 2 | Tomato-red sauce, thick and chunky with visible flecks, spread in streaks through the scrambled mass and pooling around the center, roughly 10% of plate area, moist with slight sheen | 50
ITEM 3 | Crumbled white granular mass, off-white with small irregular crumbles, dry and loose in texture, about 3 cm across, placed in the center on top of the red sauce | 25
ITEM 4 | Roasted potato wedges, golden-brown skin with browned edges and pale cream interior, dry surface, cut into irregular chunks about 3 to 4 cm long, arranged along the left and lower side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of plate area | 150
ITEM 5 | Fresh herb sprigs, bright green thin leaves and stems, scattered over the right side and across the egg mass, very light, covering about 5% of plate area | 5
